shortDescription: Manage QoS Traffic Priorities on F5OS

options.name: default_qos
options.description: Specifies the QoS for which the specified traffic priority will act as the default one.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the traffic priority.

options.name: qos_status
options.description: Specifies the status of the QoS.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), this option creates qkview file on specified remote host. If C(absent), this option deletes qkview file on the device (if it exists). When deleting a traffic priority make sure it is not the default for any QoS.
